title: Client missions
exampleQuestions: What client missions has he done?
Has he built tools for customers?
answer: Hamza carries out projects through ETIC INSA Technologies, the Junior Enterprise of INSA Lyon. He is building a tool that generates planning documents automatically from a planning software's exports for VINCI, and a Python prototype that computes material flows for a territory for Inddigo, an environmental and territorial consulting firm, with AI assistants that cite their sources. He also built the J'ai PiGé educational mobile app. All are on the Evaluation page.
